answer: Proposed: cap each licensed geologist vertex in the endorsement graph at one basalt-assay agent's daily vote, earned through 30 minutes of exclusive live review. A beacon selects auditors to check identity, attendance and the assay; validators reject reused endorsements and deny votes on failed checks. n keys need n geologists and 30n person-minutes/day. Parallel review cuts delay, not recurring labor. This requires deduplicated licences and honest audits: fake attendance erases the cost, and paid sponsors still let one owner control many votes.
